name: Kurata Ibuki
source:
A second-year student at Kayo Academy.
She is the president of the student council and the captain of the Kendo club.

She has a slender model-like figure that everyone envies, but she has a complex about her slim body and the size of her breasts.

She is weaker when it comes to play that stimulates her sense of shame than physical play.
